name: Book Employee with Spouse — Spouse DOB Without Year
goal: User provides spouse DOB without year; bot prompts for year and user completes DOB entry.
constraints: User enters '15 May' as spouse DOB; bot asks for year; user provides year; bot stores full DOB.

phases.description: User selects 'Employee with Spouse' and provides spouse name.
User enters spouse DOB without year; bot prompts for year.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks 'Could you confirm the year?'.

phases.description: User provides year; bot stores full DOB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot stores DOB in DD MMM YYYY format.
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
